tagline.text: The Sky Walk and Edge Coaster atop Crown Regency Tower

location.label: Location
location.text: Crown Regency Hotel and Towers, floors 37-38, near Fuente Osmeña, Cebu City

children.text: Near Fuente Osmeña in Cebu City, this urban thrill attraction on floors 37-38 of Crown Regency Tower offers a Sky Walk along the building's outer edge and a tilting Edge Coaster. About 127 m above the street, you get a 360-degree view of the city.

Sky Experience Adventure is an urban thrill attraction on the upper floors of Crown Regency Hotel and Towers on Osmeña Boulevard in Cebu City. The hotel stands close to Fuente Osmeña Circle in the city center, so it suits a half-day outing in town rather than a beach-resort day on Mactan Island. English Wikipedia says the attraction is on the 38th floor and includes a flat roller coaster that runs around the building's edge, plus an experience similar to the EdgeWalk at Canada's CN Tower.
Two attractions are the best known. One is the
Sky Walk Extreme
, a walk on a platform of stainless steel and bulletproof glass hung outside the building's wall. It is about
above the ground, and clipped by a body harness to an overhead safety line, you can stand, sit or lie down on the edge for photos. The other is the
Edge Coaster
, a two-seat platform that circles the building on a rail from the 38th floor and is said to tilt forward by up to 55 degrees at the rider's lever.

The operator reopened the Sky Walk on April 15, 2025 and says it replaced the safety line and harnesses with equipment from the UK maker K-Strong. However, the operator's official FAQ says the Edge Coaster is under renovation and will reopen later, while more recent articles describe it as operating, so the sources disagree. If you really want to ride the Edge Coaster, check with the hotel or the attraction's official Facebook page before you go.

Even people with a strong fear of heights need not worry, because you can buy an entrance ticket only and go up just for the view. You can see the city skyline and, in the distance, the sea and ridgelines toward Mactan, so it is a good addition to a Cebu City itinerary on any day except a rainy one. Many families visit, but there are limits on health and age, so read the cautions below first. Unlike places such as Oslob or Moalboal that take a whole day, it takes only two to three hours, so it fits a short gap such as the afternoon of arrival day or the evening before departure.
This signature experience is a harnessed walk on the outer platform at the 37th floor. Per the official FAQ it lasts about
10-15 minutes
, with a 360-degree view of Cebu City. The highlight is posing on the edge, leaning out or lying down.
A two-seat platform circling the building on a rail on the 38th floor, it is described as tilting forward by up to about 55 degrees under lever control. One ride is said to take about
10 minutes
. Whether it is running changes from time to time, so be sure to check before you visit.

Even without riding, an entrance ticket lets you go up to the high floors for the view. Around sunset the city lights come on, so you can see both the day and night faces of the city. Personal items cannot be taken on the ride section, so enjoy the view fully on the viewing floor.

According to the official FAQ, a professional photographer accompanies you and takes photos during the experience. Phones and cameras cannot be taken on the ride, so buying these photos is the standard way to get souvenir pictures. Check the photo price on site.

The operator says the Sky Walk's safety line and harnesses were upgraded to UK-made K-Strong products with a fall arrester. Staff check the safety equipment and harness fitting in person before you go out.

Tickets are sold at the 19th-floor counter in Tower 1. If you bought online, just show a printout or your phone screen at the Sky ticket counter. Rides are first come, first served with no reservation required, so walk-in purchases are possible.

A combo of the all-you-can-eat dim sum dinner at the Chinese restaurant Wang Shan Lo, entrance to Sky Experience and the Sky Walk is advertised at ₱1,400 per person. It is convenient if you want to take care of dinner and the attraction in one go.
Head from the Fuente Osmeña Circle side to Crown Regency Tower 1. Business starts at
, so the attraction will not open even if you arrive earlier.
Buy your entrance and ride tickets at the 19th-floor counter and leave your bag and phone in a locker. If you booked online, just show the screen.
After the safety briefing and harness fitting, do the Sky Walk. It takes about
10-15 minutes
If the Edge Coaster is running, ride it next. If it is under renovation, rest while looking over the city from the viewing floor.
Check the photos taken by the professional photographer and buy only the ones you want.
In the sunny afternoon the sun is strong, so bring a hat and sunscreen. You cannot take belongings on the ride.
Arrive and buy tickets. On a clear day, it is best to go up in time for sunset.
The Sky Walk around sunset has a different mood from the daytime. Choose a time when the photo spots are not crowded.
If you bought the dim sum dinner combo, eat at Wang Shan Lo. Check how to use the combo when you buy the ticket.
Take a Grab or taxi from the hotel entrance back to your lodging. Ride requests increase late at night, so allow extra time.

A nonstop flight from Manila (NAIA) to Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB) takes about
1 hour 20 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes
. Several flights a day operate, depending on the airline.
After arriving in Cebu City, take a Grab or taxi from the airport to Crown Regency. Travel time varies greatly with traffic, so avoid rush hours.

items.title: Taxi or Grab within Cebu City

children.text: Ask to go to Tower 1 of Crown Regency Hotel and Towers, next to Robinsons Fuente near Fuente Osmeña. A 2018 blog said a taxi or Grab from Ayala Center Cebu or SM City Cebu cost about ₱80-120, so fares may be higher now.
When you get out, saying "Crown Regency Tower 1" is the most accurate.
Fuente Osmeña Circle is a large roundabout served by many jeepney routes in Cebu City. Route numbers change often, so tell the driver on site that you are getting off at "Fuente Osmeña" and confirm.
From the circle, the hotel is a short distance away, so you can walk.

The experience takes place outside the top of the building, so it is affected by the weather. Clear, low-wind days are best, and since business starts at 2:00 p.m., many visitors aim for the time around sunset.

On rainy or very windy days, operation may be limited or stopped for safety. During the rainy season from June to November, afternoon showers are frequent, so leave some slack in your schedule and check whether it is operating just before you visit.

rows: Views tend to be clearest, and it can be crowded.

Rain or strong winds can stop operation, so decide according to the weather.

The attraction is inside Crown Regency Hotel and Towers, so staying at the hotel makes getting there easiest. The hotel has the Chinese restaurant Wang Shan Lo, which offers a separate combo with all-you-can-eat dim sum. Check room rates and availability by date on a booking site.

Around Fuente Osmeña Circle there are Robinsons Fuente and many restaurants and cafes, so it is easy to eat before or after the experience. Ayala Center Cebu and SM City Cebu, Cebu City's shopping hubs, are also a short taxi ride away.

A 2018 article also described facilities besides the Sky Walk, such as an urban zipline called Tower Zip, wall climbing, a 6D movie theater and a kids' playroom. I could not confirm whether all of them still operate, so if you are traveling with family, ask staff on site which facilities are currently available. Keep in mind too that the entrance ticket is the basic fee for the high-floor facilities, and each ride is charged separately.

Tickets are sold at the 19th-floor counter in Tower 1, and you can ride first come, first served without a reservation. On weekend and holiday evenings the line can get long, so it is best to go early.
Personal items, including phones and cameras, cannot be taken on the ride. Leave your bag and belongings in a locker, and buy the photos taken by the accompanying photographer.
Because you wear a harness, comfortable pants and sneakers are recommended.
If you are afraid of heights, you can buy an entrance ticket only and just enjoy the view.
Per the official FAQ, hours are daily
. Some articles say it is closed on Mondays, so check beforehand with the official Facebook page or the hotel at (032) 501 8888.
Sources conflict on whether the Edge Coaster is under renovation or operating. If you want to ride it, ask staff before you buy a ticket.
Official contact numbers include (032) 501 8888 and (0917) 629 2222.
Pregnant guests, people with a heart condition, high blood pressure or a serious back injury, and anyone under the influence of alcohol or drugs cannot ride.
According to the official FAQ, you cannot ride if the harness does not fit your body. Children must be able to walk on their own and fit the harness snugly.
Children aged 8 and under must ride with one parent or guardian, and those aged 18 and under need the consent of a parent or legal guardian.
The height limit for the Edge Coaster (about 52 inches or taller) and the weight limit for the Tower Zip zipline (about 95 kg) come from third-party booking sites, so confirm them on site.
Operation can stop in bad weather. Check whether it is running before you travel a long way.
Prices, hours and available rides change often. Check the latest notice.
